workflow.name: Workflow - Elevator Mirror Outfit Check (Outfit check gương thang máy) (copy)
workflow.description:
A TobyFlow Workflow using AI Models (ChatGPT + Google Flow) to swap any outfit onto a model in the viral elevator mirror-selfie scene, then animate it into a 9:16 video. Generate trendy first-outfit-check fashion content for social reels on autopilot.

Workflow TobyFlow dùng AI Model (ChatGPT + Google Flow) ghép trang phục bất kỳ lên người mẫu trong cảnh selfie gương thang máy đang viral, rồi dựng thành video 9:16. Tạo content outfit check thời thượng cho social reels tự động.

nodes.prompt:
IMAGE 01 = the elevator mirror selfie reference image with the girl standing inside a stainless steel elevator, holding a phone covering her face, wearing a fluffy cream oversized sweater, beige mini skirt, and knee-high boots.

IMAGE 02 = the uploaded outfit reference image that will replace the current clothing on the model.

Use IMAGE 01 as the primary reference for:

* elevator environment
* mirror selfie composition
* camera angle
* body pose
* hair style
* lighting mood
* body proportions
* hidden-face aesthetic
* overall realistic fashion vibe
* original person identity

Use IMAGE 02 as the exact outfit replacement reference.
Replace ONLY the clothing and accessories on the model from IMAGE 01 using the outfit from IMAGE 02 while fully preserving:

* the original person
* original pose
* original body shape
* original hair
* original elevator background
* original framing and composition
* original lighting direction
* original mirror selfie perspective

The final image must look like the same real person from IMAGE 01 naturally wearing the outfit from IMAGE 02 inside the same elevator scene.

IMPORTANT OUTFIT RULES:

* preserve all outfit details from IMAGE 02 exactly
* preserve fabric texture, stitching, folds, silhouette, fit, layering, and accessories
* do not redesign or reinterpret the outfit
* do not simplify clothing details
* maintain accurate garment proportions
* outfit must realistically wrap around the existing body pose
* preserve realistic fabric tension and gravity

PHONE REQUIREMENT:
Replace the original phone with an iPhone 17 Pro Max in elegant desert orange / soft orange titanium color.
The phone should look premium, realistic, and naturally held in front of the face.
Maintain the same hidden-face mirror selfie composition.

* realistic fabric wrinkles and movement
* no AI artifacts
